name: Default deny
rule: Access is denied unless an explicit policy grants the requested action in context.

name: Tenant isolation
rule: Tenant identity, data, cache, object, search, event and AI contexts may not cross tenant boundaries except explicitly governed platform operations.

name: Least privilege
rule: Human and service identities receive the minimum permissions and scope required for approved duties.

name: MFA for privileged actions
rule: Privileged/admin or configured high-risk actions require MFA/step-up authentication.

name: Privileged access expiry
rule: Temporary privileged elevation expires automatically and retains approval/audit evidence.

name: Joiner/mover/leaver
rule: Identity lifecycle changes propagate to memberships, roles, sessions and service access according to configured rules.

name: Session revocation
rule: Disabled/revoked identities or high-risk events can revoke active sessions/tokens.

name: Service identity ownership
rule: Every service identity has owner, purpose, scope, credential reference and rotation policy.

name: No secrets in source
rule: Production credentials, private keys and secrets may not be stored in source repositories or unprotected config.

name: Key rotation
rule: Keys/secrets/certificates follow configured rotation and expiration policy with evidence.

name: Sensitive logs
rule: Security/application logs exclude secrets and protected content unless specifically approved/redacted.

name: Data classification
rule: Protected handling/retention/export rules derive from data classification and tenant/jurisdiction policy.

name: Encryption
rule: Protected data uses approved encryption in transit and at rest according to classification/policy.

name: File scanning
rule: Untrusted file uploads are validated/scanned before trusted processing or distribution.

name: API abuse controls
rule: Sensitive endpoints support rate limiting, replay/idempotency controls and anomaly monitoring.

name: Event authenticity
rule: Security-sensitive events retain publisher identity, tenant, schema/version and correlation context.

name: Search permission filtering
rule: Search indexing/querying cannot return unauthorized records or snippets.

name: AI security inheritance
rule: AI retrieval/tool/model use may not bypass ordinary identity, tenant, classification or approval policy.

name: Prompt injection isolation
rule: Untrusted retrieved content cannot override trusted system/tool/security instructions.

name: Secure SDLC gate
rule: Blocking code/dependency/container/IaC/secret findings prevent promotion unless formally excepted.

name: Vulnerability ownership
rule: Every actionable vulnerability has severity, owner, due date/SLA and disposition evidence.

name: Security exception expiry
rule: Risk exceptions expire and require re-review; they are not permanent silent bypasses.

name: Threat modeling
rule: Material architecture/data/AI/integration changes require threat-model review based on configured risk triggers.

name: Alert integrity
rule: Security alerts preserve triggering evidence and cannot be silently deleted by ordinary users.

name: Incident evidence
rule: Security incidents preserve chronology, containment/recovery actions and forensic evidence access history.

name: Access review
rule: Privileged and configured sensitive access is periodically certified or revoked.

name: Segregation of duties
rule: Configured incompatible roles/actions are denied or routed to explicit exception/review.

name: Break glass
rule: Emergency privileged access is time-bound, strongly authenticated, monitored and retrospectively reviewed.

name: Backup security
rule: Backups use equivalent classification/encryption/access protections and restore validation.

name: Audit immutability
rule: Security/auth/admin/compliance audit history is append-oriented and protected from ordinary mutation.
